content_blocks.text: Choose the simplest mapper that makes expected result structure obvious and test type stability. Change one input or condition at a time, compare the observed result with your prediction, and write down one limitation.

content_blocks.title: Common pitfall
content_blocks.text: Do not treat a syntactically plausible example as proof of correctness. For splitting and grouped processing, check the input type, missing/empty cases, output shape, and domain assumptions.
